about: Passages a content filter may block, or that must be stated plainly without softening or sensationalising (rule 6). A day holding any of these goes to the sensitive lane: two days per agent, the text read from disk and never pasted into a prompt. Bible and Tanakh by chapter, the Qur'an by surah:ayah range, the Rig Veda by mandala.hymn. The owner reads every sensitive Qur'an day.
